rows.label: Project
rows.value: OPALCO Bell Island Submarine Power Cable Replacement

rows.label: Waterbody
rows.value: Wasp Passage and Pole Pass; Puget Sound

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: 2026 -The existing Orcas Power and Light Cooperative (OPALCO) 1-phase 7.2 kV 2/0 Cu cross-linked polyethylene (XLP)-insulated Philips-Dodge cable between Orcas Island and Bell Island was installed in 1982 and is approaching the end of its service life. The existing approximately 2,359-foot (ft.) subsea power and phone cable line between Orcas Island and Bell Island would be removed.
